import { defineSchema, defineTable } from "convex/server";
import { v } from "convex/values";

export default defineSchema({
  project: defineTable({
    bubbleId: v.string(), // primary key (Bubble _id, text)
    name: v.string(),
  }),

  task: defineTable({
    bubbleId: v.string(), // primary key (Bubble _id, text)
    attachment: v.string(),
    budget: v.any(),
    checks: v.array(v.boolean()),
    cover: v.string(),
    dates: v.array(v.float64()),
    done: v.boolean(),
    due: v.float64(),
    duration: v.any(),
    estimate: v.float64(),
    files: v.array(v.string()),
    images: v.array(v.string()),
    labels: v.array(v.string()), // enum -> option set (member values not in IR)
    notes: v.array(v.string()),
    owner: v.string(), // reference -> re-key to v.id(...)
    place: v.any(),
    places: v.array(v.any()),
    project: v.string(), // reference -> re-key to v.id(...)
    ranges: v.array(v.any()),
    scores: v.array(v.float64()),
    status: v.string(), // enum -> option set (member values not in IR)
    subtasks: v.array(v.string()), // reference -> re-key to v.id(...)
    title: v.string(),
    watchers: v.array(v.string()), // reference -> re-key to v.id(...)
    window: v.any(),
  }),

  user: defineTable({
    bubbleId: v.string(), // primary key (Bubble _id, text)
    nickname: v.string(),
  }),

  status: defineTable({
    bubbleId: v.string(), // primary key (Bubble _id, text)
    display: v.string(),
    color: v.string(),
  }),
});
